GraveColdBlood.Title: Grave-Cold Blood
GraveColdBlood.Description: Deathly cold floods the wound and makes every movement stiff and reluctant.

TheGraveRemembersYou.Title: The Grave Remembers You
TheGraveRemembersYou.Description: For a heartbeat, the victim sees the shape of its own death staring back from the attacker.

StolenVitality.Title: Stolen Vitality
StolenVitality.Description: The blow leaves the victim hollowed out, as though something essential has been dragged toward the grave.

DeadHandsDoNotRelease.Title: Dead Hands Do Not Release
DeadHandsDoNotRelease.Description: The corpse's grip lingers with impossible strength, spoiling the victim's footing and defense.

DeathsMomentum.Title: Death's Momentum
DeathsMomentum.Description: The successful strike feeds the unnatural force animating the dead, sharpening its next assault.

UndeadCriticalHits.Title: Undead Critical Hits
UndeadCriticalHits.Description: Critical consequences inflicted by undead attackers.

UndeadFumbles.Title: Undead Fumbles
UndeadFumbles.Description: Critical failures and breakdowns suffered by undead creatures.

CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Title: Critical Hits Against Undead
CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Description: Devastating blows that disrupt the unnatural existence of undead creatures.

UndeadCriticalHits.Name: Pack: Undead Critical Hits
UndeadCriticalHits.Hint: Use cards for critical hits inflicted by undead attackers.

UndeadFumbles.Name: Pack: Undead Fumbles
UndeadFumbles.Hint: Use cards for critical failures by undead creatures. The pack becomes active once it contains cards.

CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Name: Pack: Critical Hits Against Undead
CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Hint: Use cards for critical hits against undead targets. The pack becomes active once it contains cards.
